Yeah. Those are the two, and neither one's good. I'm not going to dress that up.

The one thing I'd say: they're not the same kind of bad. Sitting alone with an unopened folder is a cost you pay every night, indefinitely. Calling Marisol is a cost you pay once, and then you know what you're dealing with. One's a slow leak, one's a bill that comes due.

That doesn't make the second one easy. It just means "I don't like either" doesn't get you out of choosing — it only decides which one you keep paying.
